verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner, so GPU acceleration backends are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions Vulkan, AMD GPUs, ROCm, or any GPU backend selection. The only related item says the API server is 'powered by llama.cpp', which does not show Jan exposes a Vulkan backend.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
